svg.text: Current model: how close the network gets to the exact answer
Tested on 40,000 equations it never saw while training: 2nd- to 3rd-order linear ODEs, no outside force or pushed by a sine wave.
half of the equations are under
1 of 40,000 are off by 5% or more
Error = how far the prediction is from the exact answer, compared with the size of the answer. 1% means the two curves differ by about a hundredth of their height.
What that looks like on three of the test equations

polyline.title: exact: y′′ + 0.32 y′ + 9.05 y = 0; starting from y(0) = -1.00, y′(0) = 0.33 (case validation-o2-linear_homogeneous-g2370-i3)
predicted: y′′ + 0.32 y′ + 9.05 y = 0; starting from y(0) = -1.00, y′(0) = 0.33 (case validation-o2-linear_homogeneous-g2370-i3)

predicted: y′′′ + 2.29 y′′ + 7.17 y′ + 5.92 y = 0; starting from y(0) = 0.05, y′(0) = -0.01, y′′(0) = -0.04 (case validation-o3-linear_homogeneous-g2254-i3)

svg.text: This answer is 16x smaller than a typical one,
so even a tiny miss is a big percentage.
